QuestInfo.name: [Astra Secondary Weapon] Witness Testimony
QuestInfo.0: Go to Hotel Arcus with Neinheart to confirm with Archelon if Erion really was a master craftsman during the ancient war.
QuestInfo.1: Present Erion to Achelon to test his claims. What will happen?
QuestInfo.2: Archelon confirmed Erion's story. To work off his charges, Erion agreed to make weapons for the Alliance.
